title: Research: flag-1 I−G/2 side correction at #3532 charts costs +0 on R1 and +2 on R0 (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. Open [#3532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3532) co-hosts flag 1's head at the delivering update via R0/R1 at +2 rank mass and leaves the `I − G/2` side correction unpriced. Open [#3601](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3601) priced flag 43's entry at #3508's cut with co-host discount 0. This package answers the same question for **flag 1's entry `(7,0)`** (`G[7,0]=−1` ⇒ add `+1/2·X0` into `Y7`) at both of #3532's co-hosted charts.

Seven concrete corrections pass the published `check_native.validate()` with coefficients set to `0` (three newly lowered recipes, 208 adapters, 280 framed rows, 72 dirty helpers). Real words fail only at `Y7`'s endpoint; only `Y7` changes.

| Word | Base | Δ events | Δ ADDs | Δ transports | Δ rank vs base | vs published |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **E** (one ADD in FULL after R1's relocated delivering ADD) | R1 | +1 | +1 | 0 | **0** | +2 |
| **Erow** (all 48 row-7 entries there) | R1 | +48 | +48 | 0 | **0** | +2 |
| **T** (`Y7: A3→FULL`, ADD, `FULL→F7`) | R0 | +2 | +1 | +1 | **+2** | +4 |
| **S** (`X0: FULL→F7→FULL` detour) | R0 | +3 | +1 | +2 | **+2** | +4 |
| **P** (one private-copy lifetime) | R0 | +5 | +1 | +1 | **+1** | +3 |
| **Trow** (all 48 entries on T's lift) | R0 | +49 | +48 | +1 | **+2** | +4 |
| **Tend** (end-cut control) | published | +2 | +1 | +1 | **+2** | +2 |

**Co-host comparison:** at R0 the correction costs +2 vs the end-cut Tend (discount 0, same as flag 43). At R1, E/Erow add **0** rank vs R1, so `Tend.rank − E.rank = 2` and the joint co-hosted+corrected word R1+E matches published+Tend at +2 vs published (R1 already lifts `Y7` into the full chart where `X0` sits).

**Obstruction.** `X7`'s own head `387` is outside `F7` (`G[7,7]=2` even) and reaches `X0` at event 1074 along `X7 –616– G11 –679– X20 –1070– G18 –1074– X0`. A least-frame sweep with the delivering ADD dropped blocks all 18 insertion classes, covering every one of the 1,116 delivering-ADD placements. Per-register mass is even ⇒ strict minimum **exactly 2**.

**Joint theorem.** Words that both co-host the head and apply the correction: with relocation the minimum is exactly **2** (R1+E); order-preserving strict words need at least **4** non-private rank (R0+T and R0+S attain 4). Only `D17`'s freedom rescues co-hosting alone, and with `D17` free all 19 correction classes stay blocked. The private route costs exactly 1 (5/5 early deliveries blocked).

**Scoped bill. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

- #3532 inputs vendored byte-identically under `inputs/pr3532/` from head `8fecbf7df7b48c9004bd10a0da6a81f33d455737`

Closest priors: [#3532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3532) (R0/R1 +2 co-host floor; leave-alone — this package does not re-certify R0/R1 optimality or the late-slot OQ), [#3601](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3601) (flag-43 format prior; discount 0), [#3451](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3451) (flag-1 chronology, cited only), [#3508](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3508) (method / class Z), `research/p104-side-correction-rank-obstruction` (end-cut +2; Tend is a control only). Soft-overlap with #3601 is template-level; scientific novelty is R1's free-ride entry (`added_vs_base.rank_mass=0`), the joint 2-vs-4 theorem with single-register census, the `X7`/`G11`/`X20`/`G18` forcing chain, and coverage of every delivering-ADD placement. Not a supplier. Does not reopen deferred flag-9 repair / pinned-late / peeled-leaf / rho=0 / V45 / group-B reprints, or the merged readout series through #2883.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-flag1-side-correction-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag1-side-correction-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag1-side-correction-bill/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag1-side-correction-bill/test_package.py

```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_FLAG1_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL flag=1 entry=(7,0) gram=-1 coefficient=+1/2 zero_mass_placements=0/18(delivery_anywhere_in_1116_slots) forcing=X7(387)-616-G11-679-X20-1070-G18-1074-X0 strict_min_added_rank=2 R0:T=+1transport+1add+2rank S=+2transport+1add+2rank P=+1rank+1private_lifetime Trow=+48add+2rank R1:E=+0transport+1add+0rank Erow=+48add+0rank row7=identity cohost_discount_R0=0 cohost_discount_R1=2 joint_min_relocated=2 joint_min_order_preserving_strict=4 native_validate=7/7 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG1_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL_INDEPENDENT entry=(7,0) coefficient=+1/2 strict_classes_obstructed=18/18(delivery_dropped)+19/19(published_order) early_private_obstructed=5/5 forcing_head=387(X7) R0:T,S,Trow=+2rank P=+1rank R1:E,Erow=+0rank Tend=+2rank joint_order_preserving_single_rescue=none rows_changed=Y7_only row7=identity new_recipes=3 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG1_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL_TESTS cases=18 clean_read_only=1 scanners=2
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-flag1-side-correction-bill outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`. Duplicate JSON keys are rejected. Corruption controls include certificate bill/obstruction/census/discount flips, vendored #3532 pin flips, wrong common chart, unrestored source, and unclosed private lifetime.

## Open next questions

1. Is there a co-hosted and corrected flag-1 word with joint added mass 1 (zero-mass late relocation plus a private-copy correction)? Blocked by #3532's late-slot OQ1.
2. Does every present-head target row need +2 for its strict side-correction entry?
3. Under the repo's actual per-rank weights, is R1+E (`H8 − H6`) cheaper than Tend (`H1 − H6 + H7`)?
